hooks.command: $ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue'; $o = & npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { $errs = ($o | Select-Object -First 8) -join "`n"; $j = @{ systemMessage = "TypeScript errors detected - 'npm run build' (the pitch build) will FAIL until these are fixed:`n$errs" } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; Write-Output $j }
